welcome: Would you care to play a hand of cards?
cards: You sit on the floor and deal. The Keeper shuffles like he's done it for five hundred years.

asks.ask: How did that passage lead me here?
answer: I made those passages, in case you should need to rest along your journey.
I am still a little sore from the making of them. I shall be quite myself again in another five hundred years.
As I told you before, I spent a tremendous amount of power to make this place.
It is a space between realities.
I made it to give you privacy, until you woke.
But that is another long story.

candle: I see you have stumbled upon that curious candle.
It will carry you to a destination of some importance. Whether that proves good or ill is up to you.
Or, of course, you may always go back the way you came.
cardsEnd: The Keeper wins, and pretends to be surprised about it.
confronted: I do wonder why he has not confronted you yet.

meanCards.ask: "Cards? Is that all you do in here?"
answer: Mostly. Cards, and waiting for you.
Forgive me. I shan't take it personally. I have had a very long time to practise not taking things personally.

meanAsk.ask: "Do you ever just answer a question?"
answer: Now and then. It rarely helps.
But I shall try harder. For you.
